title: MV Jireh remains grounded after Tropical Storm Isaac
description: The 202-foot grounded freighter Jireh remains grounded after Tropical Storm Isaac on Mona Island, Puerto Rico Aug. 25, 2012. Response crews are removing sections of the ship to reduce weight, protect the hull and increase buoyancy before refloating and sinking the vessel. U.S. Coast Guard photo by Petty Officer 2nd Class Walter Shinn. Available in high definition.
